full_prompt_en: A square stylized 3D character image shows a fuzzy yellow sphere standing on a rough gray surface in low white mist. The background falls from pale blue-gray at the left into deep navy toward the upper right, with no distinct setting beyond the haze. The round body is centered slightly above the middle, leaving a band of textured ground at the bottom. Short dense fibers cover the yellow surface, catching light along the upper rim and turning the edge softly irregular. The left side of the sphere is shaded brownish gold, while the front and right glow a clearer amber yellow. Two tall black oval eyes sit near the upper center of the face. Their white highlights are large and sharply reflected, making the gaze bright and slightly upward. Below them, an open oval mouth interrupts the yellow with a deep dark cavity and a visible warm pink tongue. A rounded yellow lip catches a thin strip of light along the lower opening. Beneath the body, two red rounded feet spread outward, partly hidden by drifting vapor. A narrow dark gap separates the sphere from the ground between the feet, making its weight and stance easy to read. The foreground surface is grainy and uneven, with shallow pits and pale frosty areas. Mist curls across the lower left and behind the feet, softening the transition between character and setting. Cool diffused light comes from the upper left and rear, drawing a pale rim around the top and leaving the ground darker toward the viewer. Warm light on the front face contrasts with the cool blue surroundings, and gentle depth of field keeps the eyes crisp while the farther ground fades. The overall composition isolates a simple surprised expression inside cinematic haze, balancing a bright soft sphere against dark open space for playful suspense.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风格化三维角色图像描绘一个毛茸茸的黄色球体，站在低低的白雾里、粗糙的灰色地面上。背景从左侧浅蓝灰逐渐落入右上方深海军蓝，雾以外没有清楚的具体场景。圆形身体位于中央略偏上方，在底部留下一道有肌理的地面。短而密集的纤维覆盖黄色表面，沿上缘承接光线，让边缘显得柔软而略不规则。球体左侧被染成棕金色阴影，正面和右侧则发出更清亮的琥珀黄色。两只竖长的黑色椭圆眼睛位于面部上方中央。大而锐利的白色反光让目光明亮，略微向上。下方，一张张开的椭圆嘴以深色腔体打断黄色，里面可见暖粉色舌头。圆润黄唇沿开口下缘承接一条细亮光。身体下方，两只红色圆脚向外分开，被飘动的水汽部分遮挡。脚间有一道狭窄深色缝隙把球体与地面分开，使其重量和站姿清楚可读。前景地面颗粒粗糙且不平整，带浅浅凹坑和浅色霜状区域。雾气从左下卷过，也绕到双脚后方，柔化角色与环境的连接。冷色漫射光从左上方和后方照来，在顶部描出浅色轮廓，让靠近观者的地面更暗。正面暖光与周围冷蓝色形成对比，轻柔景深让眼睛清晰，远一点的地面逐渐淡出。整体构图将简单的惊讶表情隔离在电影感薄雾中，以明亮柔软球体平衡深色空旷空间，形成活泼的悬念。
style_prompt_en: The stylized 3D image gives extremely simple rounded geometry a soft fibrous surface and cinematic atmospheric depth. Fine short fibers break the silhouette and hold pale rim highlights, while broad smooth shading underneath preserves a clear readable volume. A saturated warm focal mass stands against cool blue-gray and navy surroundings, creating strong temperature contrast without a busy palette. Large glossy dark ovals and one deep recessed shape supply high contrast details inside the otherwise continuous color field. Low drifting mist obscures contact points and softens the grainy ground plane, but a small dark gap and grounded shadow maintain physical coherence. Diffuse backlight traces the outer edge, and a warmer front fill keeps the focal surface lively. Shallow focus sharpens the nearest expressive features while allowing background forms to dissolve. The overall effect is playful and suspenseful, with tactile softness set inside a spacious, moody stage.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格化三维图像给极其简单的圆润几何赋予柔软纤维表面和电影感大气纵深。细短纤维打破剪影并承接浅色轮廓光，下面的宽阔平滑阴影仍保有清晰可读的体积。饱和暖色焦点体块立在冷蓝灰与海军蓝环境前，以不繁杂的调色范围建立强烈冷暖对比。巨大的亮面深色椭圆和一处深凹形状在原本连续的色域内部提供高对比细节。低低飘动的雾遮蔽接触点，柔化颗粒状地面，但一道小小暗缝和贴地阴影仍维持物理连贯性。漫射逆光描出外缘，较暖的正面补光让焦点表面保持活力。浅景深使最近处的表情特征清晰，让背景形体渐渐消散。整体效果活泼而带悬念，可触的柔软感置于宽阔、情绪浓郁的舞台之中。
theme_en: A fuzzy yellow round character standing in low mist with a surprised expression
theme_zh: 一个毛茸茸的黄色圆形角色站在低雾中，露出惊讶表情
name: Pac-Man
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
